interface.shortDescription: Outcome execution, plan stress-testing, retrospectives, research, handoff, and domain modeling
interface.longDescription: Personal methodology skills: outcome execution (go), plan stress-testing (grilling), retrospectives that file lessons and improve the environment (retro), code simplification (my-simplify), plus vendored Matt Pocock skills for bug diagnosis, background research, conversation handoff, domain modeling with CONTEXT.md and ADRs, and re-pitching an unclear message. Every skill is self-contained and follows the portable Agent Skills layout for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Kimi Code, and compatible clients.
